title: Update metadata references from draft-01 to draft-02
description:
draft-ietf-jmap-metadata-02 eliminated the standalone Metadata object type. Metadata is now per-type properties (metadata, privateMetadata) on opted-in data types declared in the session capability's dataTypes map.

The chat spec (draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00) has three MAY notes (lines 508, 608, 733) that use draft-01 terminology (objectType, relatedType, relatedId) which no longer exists:

1. Chat objects (line 508): 'Implementations MAY support JMAP Metadata for private client-side annotations on Chat objects (using objectType: "Chat")'
2. Message objects (line 608): same pattern for Message
3. Space objects (line 733): same pattern for Space

Reword all three to reflect draft-02 architecture: server declares the type in urn:ietf:params:jmap:metadata capability's dataTypes map, objects gain metadata/privateMetadata properties readable/writable via standard Foo/get and Foo/set methods. No new sections, methods, or fields needed — just rewording the existing informative notes.

Also update the JMAP-METADATA reference from -01 to -02.
close_reason: Rewrote three JMAP-METADATA notes (Chat :508, Message :608, Space :733) to use draft-02 dataTypes/metadata/privateMetadata architecture; removed stale objectType terminology. Reference URL already tracks latest draft.
